sentences.text: Agujaceratops was a large dinosaur measuring about 4.3 meters in length and weighing 1.5 metric tons.
Some researchers estimate the animal could reach nearly 5 meters in length, 3 meters in height, and weigh 2 tons.
The back of the frill features a strong notch that creates a heart shape, accompanied by three or four pairs of spike-like hornlets.
Numerous low, blunt hornlets along the frill edges create a strongly scalloped appearance.
The brow horns are oriented upward and outward, curving backward when viewed from the side.
Material was found in 1938 in Big Bend National Park by William Strain.
The genus Agujaceratops was named by Lucas, Sullivan, and Hunt in 2006.
Agujaceratops was a quadrupedal herbivore, like other ceratopsids.
Agujaceratops was originally classified under the genus Chasmosaurus before being moved to its own genus.
The animal lived approximately between 75 and 70 million years ago during the Campanian in what is now North America.
During this time, the Aguja Formation was located along the western margin of the Western Interior Seaway.
The habitat where fossils were found may have been a swamp, based on the nature of the sediments.
Agujaceratops was found in the strata of the Aguja Formation in the state of Texas, USA.
